s00343.summary: Corinne explores the mirror maze and questions Artie about a stranger reflection
Corinne sees her reflection move on its own and Artie confirms it
Corinne begs Artie to take her out, but he is lost too
Corinne sees young Artie in the mirrors and realizes she is trapped

s00548.summary: Bhaskar answers Willoughby's small talk about the rain delay with silence
Bhaskar demands an apology for the run-out and Willoughby defends it
Florence pushes in from the rain and calls the match off
Florence and Bhaskar together call Willoughby's run-out deliberate foul play
Willoughby concedes and is pressed into apologizing to everyone and the game
Florence insists on tea and the three old foes sit together

s01999.summary: Miriam sits in the old booth and tests the microphone
Miriam listens to her younger self on the reel and answers back
Miriam tells her old broadcast voice that Walter died, and reassures it
Miriam records a final goodbye before the station closes, echoing her old sign-off

s00579.summary: High on the tower, Jules teases Odette about the harness she stitches
Odette makes Jules put on the harness and tightens it firmly
Inspector Bouchard climbs up the ladder and calls for Jules
Bouchard questions Jules about Tuesday night, contradicting his alibi
Odette gives Jules an alibi and Bouchard pointedly accepts it
Bouchard descends and Odette and Jules let their breath out
Jules thanks Odette, who insists she had to, and resumes sewing

s01698.summary: The traveler asks to cross and Orval demands a true story as toll
Maelis unhoods and tells Orval she was a queen who lost her crown
Maelis admits killing her brother, and Orval accepts it as payment
Maelis crosses the swaying bridge, stepping over the third plank
Orval helps her up and questions whether she is still Maelis

s01017.summary: Ingrid and Baptiste tend the huskies in the checkpoint tent
Race Control orders Ingrid out in twenty minutes before a storm
Baptiste points out Ash collapsed, and Ingrid crawls to her dog
Baptiste pulls Ash from the team and Ingrid refuses to accept it
Ingrid scratches her team from the race to stay with Ash
Baptiste smiles and brings water for Ash under the aurora

s00099.summary: Clemence challenges Suleiman about sharing her sleeper compartment
Clemence presses Suleiman to admit why he really came to Lyon
Suleiman admits he got on her train on purpose
Face to face, they admit counting the years apart
The train throws her into his arms and neither lets go
Clemence slaps him twice, then breaks down clinging to him

s00869.summary: Alaric draws water from the runed well and drinks
Percival steps out of the trees and Alaric reaches for his sword
Percival explains the well shows what you lost and urges Alaric to look
Alaric looks into the well and is undone by what he sees
Alaric wipes his tears while Percival tactfully looks away
Percival offers to walk with him and follows at a distance

s01016.summary: Wyatt leads the group through the moonlit corn maze
At a fork the group argues over which way they came
Stalks snap closer and Wyatt kills the light
A tall feed-sack-headed figure rises and stares at them
The group sprints through the corn, pursued by the gliding shape
In the clearing a scarecrow turns its head, and they scatter

s00318.summary: Zuri hosts a pretend tea party for six adults at a tiny table
A pretend spill sparks squabbling until everyone points at someone else
Zuri declares nap time and the adults obediently lay their heads down

s00999.summary: Iyer prepares Ludmilla for surgery aboard a rattling hospital train
Ludmilla notices his shaking hands and Iyer admits they always shake
Iyer cleans and clamps the wound as Ludmilla fights the pain
Mid-surgery Ludmilla confesses her papers are false and she is a courier
Ludmilla begs Iyer to memorize the name in her coat lining
Iyer takes the name Commander Alder, station nine, and repeats it
Iyer finishes the last suture as Ludmilla's voice fades
Iyer checks her pulse and finds she is still breathing
Exhausted, Iyer goes to her coat and finds the lining
Ludmilla catches him at the coat; he says he never forgets names

s00543.summary: Francine struggles with a flat tire and refuses Lenny's help
Lenny says Mom called asking if Francine is coming Sunday
Francine resents Mom's lies; Lenny says moving away was leaving
Francine throws Lenny's two years of absence back at him
After a brittle laugh Lenny admits he should have called
Lenny breaks the lug nut and they change the tire together
Talk of their father surfaces Lenny's memory of comforting her
Lenny tells Francine their mother is sick
Their hands meet on the wrench and Francine agrees to Sunday

s01379.summary: The team watches tensely as Ruby steps up in a tied ninth frame
Artie asks for a spare and Ruby throws, leaving one pin
The ten pin wobbles and everyone holds their breath; it stands
Ruby silently retreats to the bench and folds her towel
Artie consoles her and Devon hands back the ball, urging another try

s01985.summary: Arslan appears dripping in the greenhouse doorway where Izabela sits
Izabela needles Arslan about walking eleven miles to make a point
Over chicory they banter about his blowtorch coffee from years ago
Izabela admits she still maintains the smoke alarm for him
Arslan asks about the orchid; Izabela says it bloomed after eleven years
Arslan sees the orchid and says it looks like her
Izabela laughs and joins him; Arslan vows to wait for the next bloom

s00161.summary: Ifeoma leads her crew through the freezing vault against the clock
Hakon opens the drawer and the crew loads the wheat seed
Klaxons sound and the bridge reports six minutes left
Commander Larkspur enters with a drawn gun and forbids touching the seed
Ifeoma steps forward and appeals to their shared oath
Larkspur lowers his gun and unlocks the vault for them
The crew races off with the seed as Larkspur watches

s02293.summary: A clown waits stiffly in the dentist's office among staff and a wailing boy
Gus explains he is the unbooked entertainment and honks his nose
Milo shrieks and the adults collide over the lollipop bowl
Milo stops crying, delighted, and asks Gus to honk again

s00569.summary: Backstage, Mortimer and Beatrice tease nervous Hugo about twitching
Hugo says he can't do it and Mortimer tells him to be sassy
The PA calls Hugo to the finale and he feels sick
The dummy falls and all three pile up chasing it
They untangle and Beatrice tapes the dummy's jaw and lamb's ear
Mortimer advises Hugo to freeze convincingly as the clock runs down
Hugo's trembling baa gives the lamb personality at last
Hugo marches to the stage, the others following into the applause

s00129.summary: In the church bowling alley Rosalind recalls her late husband to Deacon
Nadine hints that twelve years of silence on the lane hides something
Deacon asks his mother what he should know; she deflects
Gus reveals Deacon's father kept two families who met on this lane
Nadine confirms Deacon's father was her father too
Deacon sets the ball down and it rolls a strike
Gus explains it is the lane's last night to share
Deacon offers Nadine the blue ball and she takes it

s02435.summary: Calloway eats beans and trades dry remarks with Magdalena at supper
Reuben worries the coach is late and Homer mentions something outside
Abigail asks why a marshal waits here; Calloway evades
Reuben names the killer as Abigail confesses at the same moment
Abigail removes her gloves and explains Boyce killed her husband
Homer drops the pot and Calloway orders the door locked

s01922.summary: In the projection booth Lula teases Teo for sweating
Hamid arrives uninvited and claims Lula invited him too
Lula insists she only said they might hang out
Hamid mocks Teo's paper hat and Teo rises gripping the reel
Mrs. Vanterpool appears asking why the screen is blank
Teo takes the blame and she hands back the reel to fix

s00028.summary: Roman appears at the storeroom with carnations while Eloise counts stock
Eloise coolly notes he is three years late
Roman explains his mother's illness and asks only to stand there
Eloise turns, learns his mother died, and softens
Eloise asks about his stupid scarf and Roman laughs with relief
The party crowd enters led by tipsy Dr. Penhallow
Penhallow reveals Eloise has talked about Roman for three years
Pressed together for a photo, they make dinner plans and laugh
Facing a squid lecture, Eloise and Roman slip out the back

s00807.summary: Andrej crawls through the duct above the laser grid and starts rehearsing
Andrej fights off a sneeze in the dusty duct
Andrej catches an extra digit in the combination and corrects it
Andrej memorizes the code and jokes about being a pastry chef
A red light sweeps the vent; Andrej freezes, then begins step one

s00030.summary: Maren confronts her father for selling her mother's hives
Maren says she drove six hours fearing he was sick
Florian explains he can no longer lift the supers
Silence falls; a bee lands and Maren finally sits
Florian has Maren taste the last honey he saved for her

s01357.summary: The kitchen crew shares a bottle with a silent stranger after close
The crew trades guesses about who the stranger is
The stranger reveals he is Leopold, who once cooked here
Leopold says the soup needs salt and Imani adds a pinch

s01406.summary: Bernadette stands at the running tap beside her husband's coat
The phone rings and Bernadette lets it before answering
The hospice nurse tells Bernadette her husband has died
Bernadette quietly declines help and insists she is fine
Bernadette pours tea for the empty chair and sits across from it
